20261121-chemistry-e2-2.material: Kedu mgbanwe ọnọdụ ihe na ụzọ nkewa a na-eji n'ebe a na-eme nnu (salt pan) iji nweta nnu dị ọcha e ri site na mmiri oké osimiri?
20261121-chemistry-e2-2.thinking.0: Kedu mgbanwe ọnọdụ ihe na ụzọ
20261121-chemistry-e2-2.s.s1.prompt: Kedu mgbanwe ọnọdụ ihe na ụzọ nkewa a na-eji n'ebe a na-eme nnu (salt pan) iji nweta nnu dị ọcha e ri site na mmiri oké osimiri?
20261121-chemistry-e2-2.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na e debe mmiri oké osimiri n'ebe a na-eme nnu ma anyanwụ na ikuku kpọpụ mmiri ya, naanị mmiri na-aghọ ikuku mmiri pụọ, ma kristal nnu gbazere na-ahụ ọcha.
